facts.fact: Google states that 30% of all mobile searches are related to location.
facts.quote: 30% of all mobile searches are related to location.

facts.fact: According to Google, 78% of people who search for something nearby on their phones visit the business within a day.
facts.quote: 78% of people who search for something nearby on their phones visit the business within a day.

facts.fact: According to Google, 28% of searches for something nearby result in a purchase.
facts.quote: 28% of searches for something nearby result in a purchase.

facts.fact: Google states that customers are 70% more likely to visit businesses with a complete Business Profile.
facts.quote: customers are 70% more likely to visit businesses with a complete Business Profile.

facts.fact: Google states that customers are 50% more likely to consider buying from businesses with a complete Business Profile.
facts.quote: They’re also 50% more likely to consider buying from them.

facts.fact: A Google Business Profile is free to create, according to the page.
facts.quote: It’s free and allows your business to appear in the map pack and Google Maps.

facts.fact: In BrightLocal's survey, 36% of SEOs think a Google Business Profile is the most important ranking factor for the map pack.
facts.quote: 36% of SEOs think your Google Business Profile is the most important ranking factor for the map pack.

facts.fact: In BrightLocal's survey, 6% of SEOs think a Google Business Profile is the most important ranking factor for regular organic results.
facts.quote: And 6% believe that it’s important for the “regular” organic results.

facts.fact: In BrightLocal's survey, 17% of SEOs deem reviews the most important ranking factor for map pack rankings.
facts.quote: BrightLocal’s 2021 study shows that 17% of SEOs deem reviews the most important ranking factor for map pack rankings.

facts.fact: In BrightLocal's survey, 5% of SEOs see reviews as the most important ranking factor for regular organic rankings.
facts.quote: But only 5% see them as most important for regular organic rankings.

facts.fact: In BrightLocal's survey, 7% of SEOs think citations are the most important ranking factor for both the map pack and regular results.
facts.quote: BrightLocal’s 2021 study shows that 7% of SEOs think citations are the most important ranking factor.

facts.fact: In BrightLocal's survey, the share of SEOs rating Google Business Profile signals as most important for the local pack rose from 23% in 2013 to 36% in 2021.
In BrightLocal's survey, the share of SEOs rating review signals as most important for the local pack rose from 12% in 2013 to 17% in 2021.
In a BrightLocal survey table, the Local Pack/Finder share was 18% in 2013 and fell to 7% in 2021; the metric label is not shown in the chunk.
In a BrightLocal survey table, the Localized Organic Results share was 11% in 2013 and 7% in 2021; the metric label is not shown in the chunk.
facts.quote: | Localized Organic Results | 11% | 11% | 10% | 8% | 9% | 6% | 7% |

facts.fact: BrightLocal's study found that 31% of SEOs deem links the most important signal for ranking on regular organic search.
facts.quote: BrightLocal’s study shows that 31% of SEOs deem links the most important signal for ranking on regular organic search.

facts.fact: BrightLocal's study found that 13% of SEOs think links are the most important signal for map pack rankings.
facts.quote: 13% think the same for map pack rankings.

facts.fact: In BrightLocal's link-importance table, the Local Pack/Finder share was 12% in 2013 and 13% in 2021.
In BrightLocal's link-importance table, the Localized Organic Results share was 24% in 2013 and 31% in 2021.
facts.quote: | Localized Organic Results | 24% | 25% | 25% | 29% | 28% | 31% | 31% |

facts.fact: BrightLocal's study found that 34% of SEOs think on-page signals are the most important factor for regular organic search.
facts.quote: BrightLocal’s study shows that 34% of SEOs think on-page signals are the most important factor for regular organic search.

facts.fact: BrightLocal's study found that 16% of SEOs believe on-page signals are the most important factor for map pack rankings.
facts.quote: And 16% believe it’s the most important factor for map pack rankings.

facts.fact: In BrightLocal's on-page signals table, the Localized Organic Results share rose from 27% in 2013 to 34% in 2021.
facts.quote: | Localized Organic Results | 27% | 27% | 26% | 24% | 26% | 32% | 34% |

facts.fact: Keyword Planner shows broad search volume ranges, such as 1K–10K, rather than absolute numbers.
